description: This Java class 'SelfBeneficiariesTPTDataValidator' provides validation logic for creating and updating self-beneficiary transfer data in the Fineract platform. It checks JSON input for required fields, value constraints, and unsupported parameters.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for self-beneficiary transfer data, handling create and update JSON validation.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a self-beneficiary transfer, ensuring required fields and constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a self-beneficiary transfer, allowing partial updates.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws exception if validation errors are present.
